artist.name: Maroon 5
artist.scopeNotes: Year is the year of first commercial release, not the parent album’s release year; the two differ in several cases, for example "Memories" was released in 2019 but appeared on Jordi in 2021. Included: every recording released under the Maroon 5 name, covering studio albums, deluxe and territory-specific editions, re-releases, compilations, covers, soundtrack contributions, non-album singles, and charting remix singles. Excluded: live versions of songs already listed; all tracks on Call and Response: The Remix Album (2008); guest features by individual members on other artists’ records. Kara’s Flowers material is kept as a separate era because it predates the Maroon 5 name and the addition of James Valentine, though the core lineup is the same. The one plausible remaining gap is a territory-exclusive bonus track undocumented on Wikipedia; Japanese, Korean, and Australian editions are where those hide.
